evidence: dead_air: From hook@1.5 to seg0:end (about 1.5s to 5.8s) the bar chart is identical and only Data's arms shift. seg4 then repeats the seg3 circles unchanged.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: Both circles say '127%' and both are labelled 'Billionaire wealth' (seg3:start, seg3:mid, seg3:end). The voiceover says 'the S&P 500 alone grew 195 percent', but 195% and the S&P 500 appear nowhere. Data just stands on top of the left circle.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison machine bound the same series to both sides, so the second operand (S&P 500, 195%) never reached the scene. It drew two identical blobs with no physical comparison.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show billionaire wealth +127% next to the S&P 500 at +195%, correctly labelled, as a visible race or fill where the stock-market side clearly overtakes. Data should drive the S&P side past the billionaires, landing the 'it's mostly just stocks' punchline.
